prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a photorealistic production material source for the tiny binding knot on a historical low-poly game prop. The supplied image is the USER-APPROVED DESIGN REFERENCE. Focus ONLY on the compact knot at the left-hand binding in its UPPER long-side elevation. Generate ONE isolated compact overhand knot of old twisted natural straw cord, very close to that knot, NOT the mat or an entire roll.
Composition: SQUARE macro image, a single nearly round dense knot filling 85% of the frame, exactly straight front view as seen in the reference elevation, no perspective exaggeration, centered. The knot represents a roughly 20–25 mm object made from 5–7 mm straw cord. Several rounded tightly interwoven cord bights cross over and under each other in one compact practical knot, with clear small dark interstices. Each cord must visibly comprise twisted plies and fine longitudinal flattened grass fibres, with curved natural strand grooves following every bend. Include just tiny stub roots disappearing into the knot; NO long loose tails, no handle, no continuous rope across the frame, no loop hanging outside the knot, no mat or woven sheet.
Material: sun-faded muted grey-beige and tan cattail/rice-straw cord matching the reference, very rough dry brittle natural plant fibres, minute splits, a few very fine short frayed tips. Clear organic braided straw structure, never a smooth wooden carving, wrinkled cloth, cotton, jute sack, paper, plastic or metal. Keep the broad knot silhouette compact, almost circular and full, not an open bow or triangular trefoil diagram.
This is an ALBEDO/material source intended to be projected onto a compact rounded game mesh: neutral cross-polarized even studio light, crisp focus across the whole knot, minimal broad directional shading, natural fine cavity darkness allowed. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with full alpha outside the knot and between clearly visible little gaps. No ground or cast shadow. Exactly one knot. No panels, view grid, text, logos, watermark, measurements, modern materials or props. Preserve the reference's practical hand-tied construction and restrained dry colour.
